rationale: The stock gapped up ~4.77% on strong earnings beat news, but the last three 1-minute candles show a sharp reversal from the session high of $55.63 down to $52.53, with price now sitting at only 20.4% of today's range and below both VWAP ($53.78) and the 9-EMA ($53.60) — indicating sellers are in control after the gap. The bid-ask spread of 184.6 bps is extremely wide, making entry costly in either direction, and the violent intraday swings (low of $51.74 to high of $55.63 in the first few minutes) suggest erratic, illiquid price discovery that makes reliable stop placement difficult. With three working orders already consuming ~9% of buying power and no clear directional edge given the conflicting signals (bullish catalyst vs. bearish price action), skipping is the prudent choice.
